messages:
Sofia: Heads up team I just got INV-2026-211 from NebulaGrid for $53,740. No PO on the PDF and vendor didn't reference our PO amendment. Can AP pause payment? /cc @Ken @Maya

ap-bot: invoice INV-2026-211 uploaded to AP queue. auto-pay: active

Ken: AP here I'll stop the auto-pay if you confirm hold. Need GL and cost center. Policy: invoices over $50k require PO match or exec approval.

Maya: This was for Dedicated pool (Q1 burst). We have PO NG-5567 for $45k approved by Jordan. Looks like metered overage billed for $8,740.

Jordan: Confirmed PO NG-5567 exists. Contract section 6.1 allows metered charges but vendor should reference PO on invoice.

Procurement: Can we amend the PO to include anticipated overage? If vendor can reissue two invoices we can pay PO-backed portion.

Ken: I've set AP flag HOLD_MANUAL and created ticket AP-6482 to block payment cycle.

Sofia: I'll ask NebulaGrid to either reissue with PO NG-5567 referenced or split the invoice into $45,000 (PO) + $8,740 overage with itemized usage. Sending note to billing@nebulagrid.com now.

Legal: If vendor insists on single invoice and contract supports metered billing, we'll need an exec approval email chain to proceed. Looping Legal for review if needed.

Maya: Eng can produce usage report and a short rationale for the overage. Jordan, can you pre-approve up to $10k pending usage logs?

Jordan: I can provisionally approve up to $10k if Procurement attaches usage report and contract excerpt. Otherwise hold and escalate.

Sofia: Message sent to vendor: "Please reference PO NG-5567 on INV-2026-211 or split into two invoices (PO amount $45,000 + overage $8,740) with an itemized usage report. We cannot process >$50k without PO or exec approval."

ap-bot: AP ticket AP-6482 status=waiting_on_vendor. Reminder set for 2 business days.

Ken: Will wait for vendor reply and Jordan's confirmation. Holding payment until resolved. :hourglass:
